'''Code masking''' was a tactic used by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] to stay one step ahead of [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]]. Pirates used a [[masking code modulator]] to interfere with a [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder code]]. The modulator created a new transponder code, or at least one that was similar to that used by another ship. When active, the masked ship appeared to be another vessel of the same model.<ref name="PP" />
